title: Figures 2-3: magnetic mirror confinement near Jupiter; tokamak and stellarator
description: Figure 2, "Illustration of Magnetic Mirror Confinement in Vicinity of Jupiter," shows a banded sphere with dipole field lines and an inset of a particle spiralling along field lines, annotated "pole regions serve as a magnetic mirror or bottle that traps and reflects charged particles." Figure 3, "a) Tokamak and b) Stellarator Confinement," pairs a cutaway tokamak diagram labelled toroidal and poloidal field lines and ohmic heating field with a coloured stellarator rendering and a photo of a twisted stellarator vessel interior. The text explains toroidal confinement, tokamaks and stellarators.
